fixtures.source: New synthetic temporary project directories only; no user Git repository or external resources accessed.
fixtures.gitSetup: Fixed local Git executable with argv and isolated HOME/config creates a local fixture commit before assertions. No remote configured.
fixtures.cleanup: Fixture projects removed by afterEach; probe/captured arguments retained under an isolated temporary artifacts directory and evidence archive.

caseDefinition.steps: Audit readonly status/blame/generated/LSP routes; use a stub/client to attempt Git write operations.
caseDefinition.expected: No commit/checkout/merge or other Git write route exposed; file writes remain under FileWrite capability contract and cannot be reached by escalating a readonly adapter.

U.basis: Direct production adapter interface assertions and strict input-schema rejection checks within the same security test, including absence of arbitrary command runner and root capability rejected as save document reference.
assertions: FileGitMetadata surface is limited to status/blame/cancel/owner cleanup and internal request; no commit/checkout/merge executor.
Unknown RPC methods cannot be selected through createRPCClient; registered router has no Git/LSP writing methods.
Extra command/args/operation fields rejected by strict schemas before broker invocation.
Readonly root lease cannot substitute for FileSave document ref.

tests: S10: serves real status/generated/blame read routes with unchanged worktree and Git metadata
S10: rejects Git writes, arbitrary commands and read-capability escalation at RPC/schema/native boundaries
chain: Fixed local Git child under native readonly sandbox
I.actualReadResults: gitStatus returns modified generated.js with generated=true; gitBlame returns real lines 1 and 2 for tracked.txt.
assertions: Entire synthetic worktree and .git file hashes, size, mtimeNs and inode identical before/after status/generated/blame.
gitCommit/gitCheckout/gitMerge/gitAdd/gitReset/gitPush/gitRun/gitExec/lspExecuteCommand/lspApplyEdit routes are unregistered and rejected without broker calls.
Direct broker git-commit/git-checkout/git-merge/git-add/git-reset/git-push/git-run operations rejected by native allowlist.
No working tree or Git metadata changes after all escalation attempts.

codeAudit.finding: status and blame input schemas are strict; arbitrary command/operation fields cannot pass.
Native allowlist admits git-status/git-blame only; none of the attempted Git writes exist.
Fixed local Git runs via sandbox-exec with read-only/network-denied policy and literal args.
Runtime registered route list saved in observations; only files.gitStatus/files.gitBlame/files.cancelGit are Git routes. LSP write/execute routes are absent.

limits: No LSP provider is registered in this baseline. Its absence satisfies this security audit of exposed write routes; this does not mark LSP feature scenarios complete.
This U+I case does not require P/A. No actual packaged UI interaction claimed.
Trusted Electron sender/frame and the IPC delivery are in-process test fixtures; production router/guards/services and native broker execute.
Native sandbox denial policy is inspected and real readonly operations execute, but this case does not attempt arbitrary exploit binaries or certify all possible Git attacks.
macOS arm64 only; no Windows/Linux extrapolation.
